files.name: motion-prompt-018.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Shape transition" (シェイプトランジション), one of the names in "Motion graphics moves".
Motion Prompt #018

What it is: Shapes cover the screen and uncover the next scene
What the sample shows: Coloured bands sweep across and cover the frame; when they leave, the next scene is there.
Spec:
- Day → night → day, 2.35 s each. Four horizontal bands (height 52; blue, coral, yellow, mint) whose ends are slanted by 80 px.
- Cover: 0.38–1.0 s. Each band's leading edge travels from one side of the frame to the other. Bands are delayed by 14% of the phase each, and each uses cubic ease-in-out over 58% of the phase.
- At 1.0 s, when everything is covered, the scene underneath is swapped for the next one.
- Uncover: 1.12–1.75 s. Each band's trailing edge follows with the same delays and curve, exposing the next scene.
- Direction: left to right for day→night, mirrored for night→day.
When to use it: Use it to change scenes with shapes in brand colours: chapter breaks, topic changes.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/018.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/motion.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
